tasks.goal: Implement WorkerLease v1 from design/worker-lease-v1.md. Add a strict, bounded, credential-free lease model and atomic same-host store under .cliyard/worker-leases/<runId>/<taskId>/<leaseId>.json capturing run/task/attempt/invocation, controller pid/host/exact OS identity, worker pid/pgid/OS start identity/capture mode, workspace, timestamps and active|released|cleanup-failed|unknown state. Expose exact identity capture through WorkerProcessTreeManager/ManagedWorkerProcess so Claude and Codex adapters can persist the lease immediately after spawn, before their result can be accepted; a lease persistence failure must stop the managed worker and reject the attempt rather than leave it untracked. Thread a run-scoped lease callback from Supervisor-backed codex-batch/runClosedLoop into adapters while keeping standalone/mock paths compatible. Update the same lease on normal close, timeout, cancel and spawn-error using the process-tree cleanup outcome; do not rewrite immutable identity fields or store prompts/commands/env/secrets. Short-lived exit before identity capture remains unknown, never guessed. Add `supervisor recover-workers --repo <path> [--run <run-id>] [--json]` for same-host recovery: skip live matching controllers; skip foreign hosts; for provably dead controllers and exact worker identity, terminate only the dedicated group with existing bounded TERM-to-KILL cleanup, append recovery evidence, and report resume-needed without changing RunManifest acceptance or pretending success; for missing/mismatched identities preserve lease/processes and report needs_human. Expose bounded lease counts and latest lease per task in supervisor status, treating malformed/missing leases as degraded evidence. Add tests/worker-lease.test.ts with injected inspectors plus at least one real POSIX SIGKILL fixture where a child controller creates a detached worker helper lease, is killed, and a new recover-workers invocation terminates that exact group; cover normal cleanup update, timeout/cancel, live owner skip, foreign host skip, wrong identity/needs_human, unknown short exit, malformed records, lease write failure fail-closed, and status projection. Skip real POSIX tests on win32 and preserve the exact-child limitation. Update supervisor/worker types and manifest read models only as needed. Preserve RunManifest authority and existing cleanup semantics.
nonGoals: Do not reattach to an orphaned CLI stdout.
Do not claim worker survival after controller death.
Do not implement Windows Job Objects or cross-host kill.
Do not alter task acceptance based on lease state.
Do not store commands, prompts, environment values or secrets.
Do not kill by process name, broad scan or unproven pid.
deliverables: Worker identity persists at spawn and final cleanup.
Explicit same-host recovery safely handles dead-controller worker groups.
Status exposes bounded lease and recovery evidence.
forbidden: Do not touch files outside writePaths.
Do not use pkill or process-name matching.
Do not persist raw commands or secrets.

Update README, docs/NEXT_ITERATION.md and docs/NEXT_STEP_CONTROLLER.md so WorkerLease is marked implemented while stdout reattachment, Windows Job Objects, cross-host recovery, automatic resume and daemon remain uncompleted. State clearly that RunManifest remains task authority. Run the complete test suite on the integrated HEAD before writing final measured counts.
